scope: Appendix D binary, dense and dense-to-binary direct controls; not the complete baseline matrix
warmup_choice: Pre-execution fixed first quarter of the total six-segment arm budget. The manuscript leaves duration unspecified. This value is an implementation choice, not tuned on direct-control outcomes and not reset each segment.
target_training: Same fixed PREPEND target and unchanged full verifier as primary block
dense_reward: Fraction of all verifier test cases passed; never counted as complete-task success
optimizer_boundary_note: All arms reset optimizer at the same six segment boundaries, matching the outer-round branch convention. A reward-mode switch inside a segment does not reset optimizer. This is not uninterrupted six-budget training.
continuation: Predefined same-arm final-checkpoint trajectory; no outcome-adaptive rollback or checkpoint choice. Scope changes are measured and reported, not hidden by selecting a favorable endpoint.
paired_random_streams: verge_control_v1_paired_r00 through r05, shared across these three arms; not assumed paired with the primary book stream
endpoint_use: Fresh fixed-checkpoint endpoints only; trajectory rollouts used solely for training activity and full-success events
statistics: Within-control paired endpoint contrasts are exploratory, with 2000 two-level bootstrap replicates. Cross-primary contrasts must not assume shared RNG streams. No cross-training-seed inference.
compute_claim: Each arm receives six single-branch loss-token budgets, not the four-branch search cost, the selected primary policy's actual accumulated updates, or total end-to-end compute. The separate total-compute and target-only-search controls remain required.
